author: Gametimelife
quote: It’s sad just how bad this game is.  The game looks awesome.  But the story and gameplay just aren’t there. All of the house chores really throw off the pacing of the game for me.  It feels like I’m playing the Sims.   For as long as it took to make this game, I am seriously disappointed with it.

author: Gametimelife
quote: Even better than the original!  This was such a great nostalgia trip.  It had me in tears several times just recalling moments from my childhood with this game.  It’s rare to get that feeling from a game.  This game truly does have one of the best stories in gaming.  If you haven’t played this game yet, you need to!
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
